name: Camp Tapawingo
description_short: Camp Tapawingo is a girls' overnight camp in Sweden, Maine. For 2027 it offers a seven-week full summer, two shorter sessions and a CIT program.
activities: Landsports (basketball, soccer, softball, volleyball, field hockey, lacrosse)
Waterfront (sailing, paddleboarding, canoeing, water skiing, tubing, swimming)
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on Keyes Pond, a 191-acre spring-fed pond, and is the only operator of motorized watercraft on it. All campers swim at least five days a week.

warnings: Optional add-on costs are extra: horseback riding ($850 full summer, $600 partial), Sub Senior Vagabond ($200), Senior Vagabond ($425), Senior Mount Washington Trip ($200) and Senior Lifeguard Training ($400).
Camp type was inferred as sleepaway from the multi-week sessions and Visiting Day (July 24, 2027). The page does not say 'overnight' outright.
The page says to contact the camp for discounts, so actual prices may be lower than listed.
unknowns: Camper age or grade range (only 'Sub Seniors' as rising 9th/10th graders and 'Seniors' as rising 11th graders are mentioned)
CIT program age or grade eligibility
Financial aid details (the site links to a 'Campership Fund' but this page gives no details)
Exact amounts of the sibling, alumnae and early bird discounts
Full activity list, swim and waterfront details
